description: Step 1 of gaining a new scope ('copy' to follow leaders, 'withdraw' to move funds). Returns a message to sign with your agent wallet. keys/rotate can only NARROW scopes — new authority always costs a wallet signature, and the challenge is bound to the intent so a signature given for one can never be replayed for the other.

intent.description: enable_copy = gain the copy scope; enable_withdraw = gain the withdraw scope

name: get_scope_challenge
